extraction.Name: Eunice Terry
extraction.NOTES: Through a clerical error of the person drawing a warranty deed from Sarah L. Snyder to Asa L. Snyder, the land of Eunice Terry was included in said deed. Mr. Snyder was asked to execute a quit-claim deed in favor of Eunice Terry, and promised to do so, but has not done so to date. Instructions as to how to proceed are respectfully requested. Report signed by H.M. Tidwell, Superintendent, Fort Duchesne, Utah, August 27, 1929. Fee patents were issued without the allottees' applications therefore.
